sentences.text: Aethaspis was an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Devonian period. Placodermi is the class of armored fish that dominated early Devonian waters.
The genus Aethaspis was described by Denison in 1958.
Aethaspis belongs to the family Actinolepididae. Two species were described by Denison in 1958: Aethaspis major, which is the type species, and Aethaspis utahensis.
This creature lived from the Lochkovian to the Emsian stages, between 419.62 and 393.47 million years ago.
